QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_19

question.text: The SAS framework lists 16 thematic standards numbered SAS 100 through SAS 1600. Which of the following mapping is INCORRECT?

answer.text: SAS 100 — Eradicating hunger, poverty, malnutrition, and inequality
SAS 600 — Protection of national heritage, art, and culture
SAS 1100 — Slum area development, affordable housing, and other interventions to build sustainable and resilient cities
SAS 1500 — Promoting welfare of migrants and displaced persons

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.5 maps SAS 1500 to 'Bridging the digital divide in internet and mobile phone access, addressing issues of misinformation and data protection'. SAS 1600 is the one that maps to 'Promoting welfare of migrants and displaced persons'. The other three mappings are correct. The Trap: A, B, C are all correct per Section 5.5. Only D swaps SAS 1500 and SAS 1600 — a classic distractor when standards are numbered consecutively with similar thematic overlap. Cross-Exam Context: XXIII-unique content. Candidates should memorise 100/200/400/500/1100/1300/1500/1600 pairings, as these are the most commonly mis-mapped.
